websiteContent.heroTitle: Experience Elegant Taste & Peaceful Garden Dining
websiteContent.heroSubtitle: Welcome to VRINDAVAN HOTEL, Chalisgaon's premier destination for high-quality food, pristine hygiene standards, and relaxing open-air dining.
websiteContent.aboutStory: At VRINDAVAN HOTEL, we believe that dining is not just about food, but about creating memorable experiences. Established on Hirapur Rd, Thakur Wadi, we have grown to become the trust-mark of fine Indian hospitality in Chalisgaon. Under the culinary leadership of our seasoned chefs, we blend traditional Maharastrian and diverse Indian recipes with modern dining sophistication. Our open-air garden rest area provides an oasis of peace, perfect for rich family celebrations, gatherings, and calm dinners.
websiteContent.contactAddress: Hirapur Rd, near Pragati Furniture, Thakur Wadi, Indraprastha Nagar, Chalisgaon, Maharashtra 424101, India

menu.name: Paneer Tikka Achari
menu.description: Soft cottage cheese chunks marinated in tangy pickle spices, skewered with onions and bell peppers, and roasted in our clay tandoor oven.

menu.name: Hara Bhara Kabab
menu.description: Crispy spinach, green pea, and potato patties seasoned with authentic spices and pan-fried with dynamic herbs.

menu.name: Hot & Sour Veg Soup
menu.description: Classic Chinese soup packed with shredded premium vegetables, ginger, garlic, and tangy spice broths.

menu.name: Cream of Tomato Soup
menu.description: Vibrant ripe red tomatoes pureed with fresh cream, served with crispy hand-buttered croutons.

menu.name: Veg Kadhai Premium
menu.description: A combination of daily picked fresh garden vegetables cooked in a spicy kadhai gravy with capsicum and fresh coriander.

menu.name: Kaju Curry Peshawari
menu.description: Whole roasted cashew nuts simmered in a rich, buttery, sweet and creamy brown gravy topped with fresh cream.

menu.name: Vrindavan Special Paneer Masala
menu.description: Our signature preparation consisting of hand-pressed paneer cubes cooked in a spiced rich cashew-onion-tomato double-gravy.

menu.name: Paneer Butter Masala
menu.description: Succulent cottage cheese cubes simmered in a luscious sweet tomato curry enriched with butter, honey, and dried fenugreek leaves.

menu.name: Butter Masala Dosa
menu.description: Crispy fermented rice-lentil crepe smeared with fresh butter, spiced potato mash, served with rich sambar and coconut chutneys.

menu.name: Veg Manchurian Dry
menu.description: Crispy fried vegetable balls tossed in dynamic garlic, soy sauce, and spring onion seasoning.

menu.name: Schezwan Veg Hakka Noodles
menu.description: Spicy wok-tossed long wheat noodles cooked with freshly sliced bell peppers, cabbage, carrots, and house-made Schezwan paste.

menu.name: Double Tadka Yellow Dal
menu.description: Classic yellow lentils tempered twice with lots of aromatic garlic, cumin, mustard seeds, and pure desi ghee.

menu.name: Veg Kofta Mughlai
menu.description: Rich vegetable-paneer balls cooked in a rich, mildly spiced creamy golden gravy.

menu.name: Garlic Butter Naan
menu.description: Tandoored leavened refined wheat bread seasoned with lots of minced premium garlic and brushed with fresh butter.

menu.name: Tandoori Butter Roti
menu.description: Whole wheat bread baked perfectly inside our traditional clay tandoor oven, finished with smooth desi butter.

menu.name: Special Dum Veg Biryani
menu.description: Long grain Basmati rice dum-cooked slowly with aromatic spices, fresh vegetables, mint leaves, and pure saffron water, served with dahi raita.

menu.name: Jeera Rice Basmati
menu.description: Fragrant boiled Basmati rice seasoned expertly with butter and lightly cracked cumin seeds.

menu.name: Gulab Jamun with Ice Cream
menu.description: Two golden milk-solid dumplings soaked in sugary cardamom syrup, served warm with a scoop of premium vanilla bean ice cream.

menu.name: Royal Mango Punjabi Lassi
menu.description: Thick, churned yogurt sweet beverage infused with delicious Alphonso mango pulp, served ice-cold in a traditional earthen clay glass.

chefs.name: Chef Rajendra Patil
chefs.description: Specializes in authentic Indian cuisines and North Indian Paneer delicacies with signature spice blend profiles.

chefs.name: Chef Amit Kulkarni
chefs.description: Expert in traditional tandoori artistry, perfecting hand-stretched butter naan and clay-oven roasted delicacies.

reviews.name: Sachin Marathe
reviews.text: The best family dining experience in Chalisgaon! The garden seating is extremely peaceful, and the hygiene is top-notch. Highly recommend the Paneer Tikka Masala and Garlic Naan.

reviews.name: Priyanka Deshmukh
reviews.text: VRINDAVAN HOTEL has amazing food. The service is incredibly fast and the staff is highly trained. The open-air setup in the evening with beautiful lighting makes it look so premium.

reviews.name: Rahul Sonawane
reviews.text: Extremely clean, delicious vegetarian food, and excellent parking space. The chefs really know their craft. We hold all our family parties here now.
